function: The grid-template-columns property specifies the number (and the widths) of columns in a grid layout.

defaults.Animatable: yes. Read about animatable Try it

values.function: Default value. Columns are created if needed
The size of the columns is determined by the size of the container and on the size of the content of the items in the column
Sets the size of each column to depend on the largest item in the column
Sets the size of each column to depend on the smallest item in the column
Defines a size range greater than or equal to a min value and less than or equal to a max value
Sets the size of the columns, by using a legal length value. Read about length units
Sets the size of the columns, in percent, relative to the inline size of the container
Sets the size of the columns in length or %, and works like the column will use the available space, but it will never expand the max-content size
Repeats a set of columns in the grid
Indicates that the grid will adopt the spanned portion of its parent grid in that axis
Sets this property to its default value. Read about initial
Inherits this property from its parent element. Read about inherit
